title: Exhaustive Greek & Mediterranean Genealogy (Hesiod Theogony, Deucalion, Hellen/Ion, Egypt-Phoenicia Bridge, Crete, Thebes, Heracles, Troy, Rome, Carthage & Etruscans)

nodes.name: Chaos → Gaia (Earth) & Uranus (Sky)
nodes.notes: Out of Chaos emerges Gaia (Earth), who births Uranus (Starry Sky); their union generates the 12 Titans.

nodes.name: Cronus (Kronos) & Rhea
nodes.notes: Youngest Titan who overthrows Uranus; parents of the six elder Olympians (Zeus, Hera, Poseidon, Demeter, Hestia, Hades). In Phoenician Sanchuniathon, El is equated with Kronos!

nodes.name: Iapetus (Titan) & Clymene / Asia
nodes.notes: Titan father of Atlas, Prometheus, Epimetheus, and Menoetius — frequently compared by classical and biblical scholars to Noah's son Japheth (Hebrew Yefet <-> Greek Iapetos)!

nodes.name: Oceanus & Tethys / Hyperion & Coeus
nodes.notes: Oceanus & Tethys sire the 3,000 River Gods (including Inachus of Argos and Nile!) and Oceanids; Hyperion sires Helios (Sun) & Selene; Coeus sires Leto (mother of Apollo & Artemis).

nodes.name: Zeus, Hera, Poseidon, Demeter, Hestia & Hades
nodes.role: Elder Olympian Gods (Zeus = PIE Dyaus Pitr!)
nodes.notes: Zeus (exact Proto-Indo-European linguistic cognate of Vedic Sky-Father Dyaus Pitr & Roman Jupiter!) and Poseidon become the divine progenitors of Greece's heroic royal houses.

nodes.name: Atlas (Titan) → Pleiades (Electra & Maia)
nodes.role: Bearer of the Heavens / Ancestor of Troy & Hermes
nodes.notes: Son of Iapetus; father of the Seven Pleiades including Electra (mother of Dardanus, founder of Troy!) and Maia (mother of Hermes).

nodes.name: Prometheus & Epimetheus (+ Pandora)
nodes.notes: Sons of Iapetus. Prometheus molds mortals from clay and water and brings fire from heaven; Epimetheus weds Pandora (first mortal woman) -> Pyrrha!

nodes.name: Deucalion & Pyrrha (Greek Great Flood Survivors)
nodes.notes: Deucalion (son of Prometheus) and Pyrrha (daughter of Epimetheus & Pandora) survive Zeus's world-destroying Flood in a wooden chest/ark (larnax) landing on Mt. Parnassus!

nodes.name: Hellen & Orseis (Eponym of the Greeks / Hellenes)
nodes.role: Progenitor of the Greek Peoples (3 Sons)
nodes.notes: Son of Deucalion & Pyrrha; divides the Greek world among his three sons Dorus, Xuthus, and Aeolus — the Greek 'Table of Nations'!

nodes.name: Dorus (Dorians — Sparta & Peloponnese)
nodes.notes: Eponymous ancestor of the Dorians.

nodes.name: Xuthus & Creusa
nodes.notes: Father of Ion (Ionians) and Achaeus (Achaeans).

nodes.name: Ion (Ionians / Iawones = Biblical Javan!)
nodes.role: Eponym of the Ionians (Exact Cognate of Javan)
nodes.notes: Son of Xuthus (or Apollo) & Creusa; eponym of the Ionians (Archaic Greek Iawones) — EXACT linguistic cognate of Biblical Javan (Yawan, son of Japheth, Gen 10:2)!

nodes.name: Achaeus (Achaeans)
nodes.notes: Eponymous ancestor of the Achaeans (Homer's Greeks).

nodes.name: Aeolus (Aeolians)
nodes.notes: Eponym of the Aeolians; father of Sisyphus, Cretheus, Athamas, Salmoneus, Deion, Magnes, and Perieres.

nodes.name: Sisyphus (King of Corinth → Bellerophon)
nodes.notes: Son of Aeolus; founder of Corinth, grandfather of Pegasus-rider Bellerophon.

nodes.name: Cretheus → Aeson → Jason (Argonauts)
nodes.notes: Son of Aeolus; founder of Iolcus, grandfather of Jason (leader of the Argonauts to Colchis on the Black Sea!).

nodes.name: Salmoneus → Tyro → Pelias & Neleus (→ Nestor)
nodes.notes: Son of Aeolus; ancestor of Neleus and wise King Nestor of Pylos.

nodes.name: Athamas → Phrixus & Helle (Golden Fleece)
nodes.notes: Son of Aeolus; father of Phrixus & Helle (eponym of the Hellespont).

nodes.name: Inachus (Argos) → Phoroneus & Io
nodes.role: First King of Argos & Ancestress of Egypt/Phoenicia/Greece
nodes.notes: Inachus (son of Oceanus) fathers Phoroneus (first mortal king of Argos) and Io, who wanders across the Bosporus into Egypt!

nodes.name: Epaphus (King of Egypt) & Queen Memphis
nodes.role: Son of Zeus & Io / Identified with Egyptian Apis
nodes.notes: Born to Io beside the Nile; becomes King of Egypt, marries Memphis (eponym of Egypt's capital!), and fathers Libya.

nodes.name: Libya (Eponym of North Africa)
nodes.role: Mother of Belus & Agenor (Uniting Africa, Egypt, Phoenicia & Greece!)
nodes.notes: Daughter of Epaphus & Memphis; by Poseidon bears twin sons Belus (Egypt/Babylon/Aethiopia) and Agenor (Tyre/Phoenicia)!

nodes.name: Agenor (King of Tyre / Phoenicia) & Telephassa
nodes.role: Twin Son of Libya & Poseidon / Father of Europa & Cadmus
nodes.notes: Moves from Egypt to Phoenicia (Tyre/Sidon) and fathers Europa, Cadmus, Phoenix, Cilix, and Thasus!

nodes.name: Europa → King Minos of Crete, Rhadamanthus & Sarpedon
nodes.role: Phoenician Princess → Minoan Royal House (Ariadne & Phaedra)
nodes.notes: Carried from Phoenicia to Crete (Biblical Caphtorim!) by Zeus; bears King Minos (lawgiver of Knossos; father of Ariadne & Phaedra), Rhadamanthus, and Sarpedon.

nodes.name: Cadmus (Founder of Thebes) & Harmonia
nodes.role: Bringer of the Phoenician Alphabet to Greece
nodes.notes: Son of Agenor of Tyre; settles in Boeotia, founds Thebes, and introduces the 'Phoenician letters' (alphabet!) to Greece! Fathers Semele (-> Dionysus), Ino, Autonoe, Agave, and Polydorus.

nodes.name: Semele (→ Dionysus) & Polydorus → Laius → Oedipus → Antigone
nodes.notes: Cadmus's daughter Semele bears Dionysus; his son Polydorus leads via Labdacus -> Laius to Oedipus -> Antigone, Eteocles, and Polynices.

nodes.name: Phoenix (Phoenicians) & Cilix (Cilicia)
nodes.notes: Brothers of Cadmus and Europa who settle Phoenicia and Cilicia (SE Anatolia).

nodes.name: Belus (King of Egypt — Ba'al)
nodes.role: Twin Son of Libya & Poseidon / Father of Aegyptus, Danaus & Cepheus
nodes.notes: Reigns in Egypt (name reflects Semitic Ba'al/Bel); fathers Aegyptus, Danaus, Cepheus (King of Aethiopia), and Phineus.

nodes.name: Aegyptus (50 Sons) & Danaus (50 Danaids → Argos)
nodes.role: Eponym of Egypt & Founder of Danaan Argos
nodes.notes: Aegyptus gives his name to Egypt; his twin brother Danaus flees Egypt with his 50 daughters (Danaids) to become King of Argos in Greece (Homer's 'Danaans'!). Daughter Hypermnestra marries Aegyptus's son Lynceus!

nodes.name: Cepheus (King of Aethiopia) & Cassiopeia → Andromeda
nodes.notes: Brother of Danaus & Aegyptus; rules Aethiopia/Joppa coast. Daughter Andromeda is rescued from the sea monster Cetus by Perseus!

nodes.name: Lynceus → Abas → Acrisius → Danaë → Perseus
nodes.role: Slayer of Medusa / Husband of Andromeda
nodes.notes: Descendant of Egyptian Danaus & Aegyptus; slays Medusa, rescues and marries Princess Andromeda of Aethiopia, founds Mycenae, and fathers Perses (mythic eponym of Persia!) and the ancestors of Heracles!

nodes.name: Perses (Son of Perseus & Andromeda)
nodes.role: Greek Mythic Eponym of the Persians!
nodes.notes: Herodotus (VII.61) explicitly records the ancient tradition that the Persians took their name from Perses, son of Perseus and Andromeda — a classic Greek-Iranian genealogical bridge!

nodes.name: Alcaeus / Electryon → Alcmene → Heracles (Hercules)
nodes.role: Greatest Greek Hero / Ancestor of Sparta & Macedon
nodes.notes: Great-grandson of Perseus & Andromeda (via Alcmene & Zeus). His sons (Heraclidae: Hyllus, Temenus) become the royal houses of Sparta and Macedon — and 1 Maccabees 12:21 records Sparta claiming kinship with Abraham!

nodes.name: Hyllus → Kings of Sparta (Areus I) & Argead Macedon (Philip II)
nodes.notes: Heraclidae conquer the Peloponnese (Sparta: Leonidas, King Areus I who wrote to Jerusalem's High Priest claiming descent from Abraham!) and Temenus's line founds Macedon (Perdiccas I -> Philip II).

nodes.name: Alexander the Great (Macedon → Persia, Egypt & India)
nodes.role: Conqueror Uniting Greece, Egypt, Mesopotamia, Persia & NW India
nodes.notes: Son of Philip II (Heraclid) and Olympias (claiming descent from Achilles!). Conquers Darius III of Persia, is crowned Pharaoh in Egypt, and marches to the Indus — even woven into the Persian Shahnameh as 'Eskandar' (half-brother of Dara)!

nodes.name: Tantalus (Lydia) → Pelops → Atreus & Thyestes
nodes.notes: Tantalus of Anatolia/Lydia fathers Pelops (eponym of the Peloponnese!), who fathers Atreus and Thyestes.

nodes.name: Agamemnon (→ Orestes) & Menelaus (+ Helen of Sparta)
nodes.role: Kings of Mycenae & Sparta (Sons of Atreus)
nodes.notes: Agamemnon leads the Achaeans against Troy (father of Orestes, Electra, Iphigenia); Menelaus weds Helen (daughter of Zeus & Leda, sister of Castor, Pollux & Clytemnestra).

nodes.name: Peleus → Achilles & Laertes → Odysseus (→ Telemachus)
nodes.notes: Achilles (son of Peleus & Thetis, grandson of Aeacus; father of Neoptolemus — claimed ancestor of Alexander's mother Olympias!) and Odysseus (King of Ithaca, father of Telemachus).

nodes.name: Dardanus (son of Zeus & Electra) → Erichthonius → Tros
nodes.notes: Dardanus (son of Zeus & Atlas's daughter Electra) founds Dardania near the Hellespont; grandson Tros gives his name to Troy and fathers Ilus, Assaracus, and Ganymede!

nodes.name: Ilus → Laomedon → King Priam → Hector, Paris & Cassandra
nodes.notes: Senior branch of Troy: Ilus -> Laomedon -> King Priam & Queen Hecuba, parents of Hector, Paris (Alexander), Cassandra, Helenus, and Creusa (first wife of Aeneas).

nodes.name: Assaracus → Capys → Anchises → Aeneas (+ Lavinia)
nodes.era: Fall of Troy → Migration to Italy (Aeneid)
nodes.notes: Junior Trojan branch: Assaracus -> Capys -> Anchises (+ Aphrodite) -> Aeneas, who escapes burning Troy to Italy (Latium), marries Lavinia (daughter of King Latinus), and fathers Ascanius (Iulus) and Silvius!

nodes.name: Ascanius (Iulus) → Alba Longa Kings → Rhea Silvia → Romulus & Remus
nodes.notes: Ascanius (Iulus, ancestor of the Julian clan / Julius Caesar!) & Silvius found Alba Longa -> 12 Alban kings -> Numitor -> Rhea Silvia (+ Mars) -> twin founders Romulus & Remus! Directly intersects Book of Jasher's Kittim/Zepho/Janeus chronicle of early Italy!

nodes.name: Ethbaal of Tyre → Mattan I → Queen Dido (Elissa of Carthage)
nodes.role: Phoenician Founder of Carthage (Great-Niece of Jezebel!)
nodes.notes: Tyrian royal records (Menander of Ephesus, quoted by Josephus) trace King Ethbaal (Ithobaal I of Sidon/Tyre, father of Biblical Jezebel!) -> Baal-Eser II -> Mattan I -> Pygmalion & Queen Elissa (Dido), who sails from Tyre to North Africa and founds Carthage!

nodes.name: Atys of Lydia → Lydus (Lydians) & Tyrrhenus (Etruscans)
nodes.notes: Herodotus records that during an 18-year famine in Lydia (Biblical Lud, Gen 10:22!), King Atys split his people between Lydus (staying in Anatolia) and Tyrrhenus, who sailed to Italy to found the Etruscans (Tyrsenians — widely linked by scholars to Biblical Tiras, Gen 10:2)!

nodes.name: Gens Julia → Julius Caesar & Emperor Augustus (Rome)
nodes.role: Roman Imperial Claimants of Trojan Descent via Aeneas/Iulus
nodes.notes: Julius Caesar publicly claimed descent from Aeneas's son Iulus (Ascanius) and goddess Venus/Aphrodite; his adopted heir Augustus commissioned Virgil's Aeneid to immortalize Rome's Trojan genealogy!
